summary: The agent successfully establishes a train/validation split and fits a LightGBM model for the regression task. However, it independently drops columns with missing values across train, validation, and test splits, which will almost certainly cause feature mismatches and execution errors. Furthermore, the agent applies no feature engineering, inadvertently includes the row identifier as a feature, and only evaluates a stochastic model once.
